description: Push notification infrastructure — APNs integration, Supabase device token storage, send_notification edge function, iOS NotificationService, deep link routing, notification preferences UI, and integration with existing edge functions.

userStories.title: Add device_tokens and notification_preferences tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need database tables to store APNs device tokens and per-user notification preferences so the server can send targeted push notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Create migration file in supabase/migrations/ with next sequence number

device_tokens table: id (uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()), user_id (uuid FK auth.users NOT NULL), token (text NOT NULL), platform (text NOT NULL default 'ios'), app_version (text), created_at (timestamptz default now()), updated_at (timestamptz default now())
device_tokens has UNIQUE constraint on (user_id, token)
device_tokens has index on user_id

notification_preferences table: id (uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()), user_id (uuid FK auth.users UNIQUE NOT NULL), picks_graded (boolean default true), balance_changes (boolean default true), new_members (boolean default true), pick_submissions (boolean default false), game_results (boolean default true), risk_alerts (boolean default true), marketing (boolean default false), created_at (timestamptz default now())
RLS enabled on both tables
device_tokens RLS: users can SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE their own rows (auth.uid() = user_id)
notification_preferences RLS: users can SELECT and UPDATE their own row, INSERT if not exists (auth.uid() = user_id)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create send_notification shared helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a shared helper module in supabase/functions/_shared/ that handles APNs JWT generation and HTTP/2 push delivery, so edge functions can send notifications with a single function call.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/_shared/notifications.ts

Export async function sendNotification({ event, recipientUserIds, title, body, data }) that: (1) queries notification_preferences to filter out opted-out users based on event-to-preference mapping, (2) queries device_tokens for remaining users, (3) sends APNs HTTP/2 POST to api.push.apple.com for each token, (4) deletes tokens that return 410 Gone or BadDeviceToken

Event-to-preference mapping: pick_graded/parlay_graded -> picks_graded, balance_adjusted -> balance_changes, new_member -> new_members, pick_submitted -> pick_submissions, game_results -> game_results, risk_alert -> risk_alerts
APNs JWT generation using ES256 with APNS_KEY_P8, APNS_KEY_ID, APNS_TEAM_ID from Deno.env. JWT cached in module-level variable, regenerated when older than 50 minutes
APNs payload format: { aps: { alert: { title, body }, sound: 'default', badge: 1 }, deep_link: data.deep_link }
APNs headers: authorization Bearer JWT, apns-topic com.bookiapp.booki, apns-push-type alert, apns-priority 10
Function is fire-and-forget safe — all errors caught and logged, never throws
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reads APNS_KEY_P8, APNS_KEY_ID, APNS_TEAM_ID, APNS_ENVIRONMENT from Supabase secrets. APNS_ENVIRONMENT determines api.push.apple.com vs api.sandbox.push.apple.com. Use importKey with ECDSA P-256 for signing.

userStories.title: Create send_notification edge function endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a standalone send_notification edge function that other functions can invoke via fetch, providing a clean API boundary for notification delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/send_notification/index.ts
Accepts POST with JSON body: { event, recipient_user_ids, title, body, data }
Validates that request has service role key (internal-only, not user-facing)
Calls sendNotification from _shared/notifications.ts
Returns { success: true, sent: number } with count of notifications sent
Handles CORS preflight
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This function is called internally by other edge functions via fetch to the Supabase functions URL. Validates via service_role key in Authorization header, not user JWT.

userStories.title: Create NotificationService.swift for iOS
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an iOS service that handles push notification permission, APNs token registration, and token storage in Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Booki/Services/NotificationService.swift
Class is @Observable and @MainActor
Property: isPermissionGranted: Bool

Method: requestPermission() — calls UNUserNotificationCenter.current().requestAuthorization(options: [.alert, .badge, .sound]), updates isPermissionGranted, if granted calls UIApplication.shared.registerForRemoteNotifications()

Method: registerToken(_ deviceToken: Data) — converts token to hex string, upserts to device_tokens table via Supabase client (user_id from current session, platform 'ios', app_version from Bundle.main)
Method: removeToken() — deletes all device_tokens for current user_id (called on logout)
Add UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate conformance to handle foreground notifications (show banner unless already on that screen)
Add @preconcurrency import Supabase
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use existing SupabaseManager or sbClient pattern from the codebase. Token hex conversion: deviceToken.map { String(format: '%02x', $0) }.joined(). The delegate method userNotificationCenter(_:willPresent:) should return [.banner, .sound] for foreground display.

userStories.title: Wire NotificationService into app lifecycle
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the NotificationService connected to the app delegate and auth flow so tokens are registered on launch and cleaned up on logout.
acceptanceCriteria: Add NotificationService as @State property on BookiApp or inject via environment
In AppDelegate or BookiApp, implement application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:) and call notificationService.registerToken()
In AppDelegate or BookiApp, implement application(_:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:) and log the error
On successful auth (in AuthManager or checkSession), call notificationService.requestPermission() if not already granted
On logout (in AuthManager.signOut), call notificationService.removeToken() before signing out of Supabase
Set UNUserNotificationCenter.current().delegate to NotificationService on app launch
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Check existing BookiApp.swift and AuthManager.swift for the right injection points. If app uses SwiftUI lifecycle (no AppDelegate), use UIApplicationDelegateAdaptor.

userStories.title: Add deep link routing from notification taps
userStories.description: As a user, I want tapping a notification to take me directly to the relevant screen (bet detail, member detail, picks tab, etc.).
acceptanceCriteria: Add pendingDeepLink: String? property to a shared observable (ContentView or navigation state)
Implement userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:) in NotificationService to extract deep_link from notification payload and set pendingDeepLink

In ContentView or root navigation, observe pendingDeepLink and route: booki://bet/{id} -> BetDetailView, booki://ticket/{id} -> TicketDetailView, booki://members/{id} -> PlayerAnalyticsDetailView, booki://picks -> Picks tab, booki://account -> Account tab
Deep link is consumed (set to nil) after navigation completes
Works when app is launched from killed state (cold start) and from background
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The booki:// URL scheme is already registered. Check ContentView.swift for existing tab selection logic. Use .onOpenURL or similar pattern for cold start deep links.

userStories.title: Integrate notifications into auto_refresh_games
userStories.description: As a member, I want to receive a push notification when my picks are graded so I know the result without opening the app.
acceptanceCriteria: In auto_refresh_games/index.ts, after grading bets, collect graded bet results grouped by player auth_user_id

For each player with graded bets, call sendNotification with event 'pick_graded', title 'Your pick was graded', body showing team/result/amount (e.g. 'Lakers ML — Won (+$50)'), deep_link 'booki://bet/{betId}'
If multiple bets graded for same player in one run, send one summary notification: 'X picks graded — see results' with deep_link 'booki://picks'
Also notify the bookie with event 'game_results': 'X games finalized — Y picks graded'
Notification calls wrapped in try/catch — failures logged but do not affect grading
Import sendNotification from '../_shared/notifications.ts'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: auto_refresh_games already tracks graded bets in its logic. Add notification calls after the grading loop completes. Use the existing bet data (team names, amounts, results) to build notification bodies. Fire-and-forget pattern.

userStories.title: Integrate notifications into adjust_balance and claim_invite
userStories.description: As a member, I want to be notified when my balance is adjusted. As an organizer, I want to know when someone joins my group.
acceptanceCriteria: In adjust_balance/index.ts, after successful balance adjustment, call sendNotification with: recipient = player's auth_user_id, event = 'balance_adjusted', title = 'Balance updated' for adjustments or 'Payment recorded' for paymentLogged type, body showing amount and reason if provided, deep_link = 'booki://account'

In claim_invite/index.ts, after successful claim, call sendNotification with: recipient = bookie's auth_user_id, event = 'new_member', title = 'New member', body = '{playerName} joined your group', deep_link = 'booki://members/{playerId}'
Both wrapped in try/catch, fire-and-forget
Import sendNotification from '../_shared/notifications.ts'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: adjust_balance already has the player and bookie context. claim_invite already has player name and bookie ID. Just add the notification call at the end of the success path.

userStories.title: Integrate notifications into submit_bet, submit_bets, and decline_bet
userStories.description: As an organizer, I want to know when members submit picks. As a member, I want to know if my pick is declined.
acceptanceCriteria: In submit_bet/index.ts, after successful submission, call sendNotification with: recipient = bookie's auth_user_id, event = 'pick_submitted', title = 'New pick', body = '{playerName} — {teamName} {marketType} ${stake}', deep_link = 'booki://bet/{betId}'
In submit_bets/index.ts, after successful batch submission, send one summary notification to bookie: '{playerName} submitted {count} picks', deep_link = 'booki://picks'

In decline_bet/index.ts, after declining, call sendNotification with: recipient = player's auth_user_id, event = 'pick_declined' (maps to picks_graded preference), title = 'Pick declined', body = '{teamName} {marketType} was declined', deep_link = 'booki://bet/{betId}'
All wrapped in try/catch, fire-and-forget
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: pick_declined maps to the picks_graded preference key since it's a pick status change. The bet data (team name, market type, stake) is already available in these functions.

userStories.title: Add notification preferences UI for members
userStories.description: As a member, I want to control which notifications I receive from the Account screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Notifications' row to AccountView menu (between Activity and About)
Create NotificationPreferencesView.swift with toggle list in .cardStyle() card
Three toggles for members: 'Pick results' (picks_graded), 'Balance changes' (balance_changes), 'Game results' (game_results)
On appear, fetch notification_preferences for current user from Supabase. If no row exists, insert one with defaults
Each toggle updates the corresponding column in notification_preferences via Supabase
Match existing Settings visual style (ScrollView, .background(Theme.background), cardStyle sections)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow the pattern of other settings sub-views. Use existing Supabase client. Debounce or save-on-toggle (no save button needed).

userStories.title: Add notification preferences UI for organizers
userStories.description: As an organizer, I want to control which notifications I receive from the Settings screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Notifications' row to organizer SettingsView menu (between Change Password and Subscription)
Create BookieNotificationPreferencesView.swift with toggle list in .cardStyle() card
Four toggles for organizers: 'New members' (new_members), 'Pick submissions' (pick_submissions), 'Risk alerts' (risk_alerts), 'Game results' (game_results)
On appear, fetch notification_preferences for current user from Supabase. If no row exists, insert one with defaults
Each toggle updates the corresponding column in notification_preferences via Supabase
Match existing Settings visual style
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Organizers see different toggles than members since they care about different events. Follow the same pattern as US-010.

userStories.title: Add badge count and clear on foreground
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a badge on the app icon when I have unread graded picks, and have it clear when I open the app.
acceptanceCriteria: In NotificationService, when app enters foreground (via scenePhase .active or NotificationCenter willEnterForeground), set UNUserNotificationCenter.current().setBadgeCount(0)
In send_notification APNs payload, set badge to 1 for pick_graded and balance_adjusted events
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Simple badge: always 1 when there's a notification, clear to 0 on foreground. No need to track exact unread count for v1.
